examples.text: Mas, ahora venía lo difícil. Ir hasta el pueblo, efectuar la compra y luego volverse sin despertar las sospechas de los celadores, que como Argos con cien ojos vigilaban las idas y venidas de las gentes.
examples.translation: But now came the hard part: going into town, making the purchase, and returning without arousing the suspicions of the guards—who, like Argus with his hundred eyes, kept watch over people's comings and goings.

senses.definition_en: porter, orderly

examples.english: The Infanta Margarita District Hospital in Cabra (Córdoba) has recorded the first COVID-19 death among its staff with the passing of 59-year-old hospital orderly Antonia Juan Jiménez, whose death is thus added to the other three registered among healthcare workers in the province since the start of the coronavirus pandemic.
examples.ref: 2020 December 10, “Una celadora es la cuarta víctima del Covid entre sanitarios de Córdoba”, in La Vanguardia, retrieved 15 Mar 2021:
examples.text: El Hospital Comarcal Infanta Margarita de Cabra (Córdoba) ha registrado la primera muerte por Covid-19 entre su personal con el fallecimiento de la celadora Antonia Juan Jimémez, de 59 años, cuya muerte se suma así a las otras tres registradas entre el personal sanitario en la provincia desde el inicio de la pandemia de coronavirus.
examples.translation: The Infanta Margarita District Hospital in Cabra (Córdoba) has recorded the first COVID-19 death among its staff with the passing of 59-year-old hospital orderly Antonia Juan Jiménez, whose death is thus added to the other three registered among healthcare workers in the province since the start of the coronavirus pandemic.

glosses: porter, orderly
